items.reason: A rinse-off wash that helps keep the look of the jaw area clear without a long routine.

response.routine_note: Big, painful lumps that leave marks are best looked at by a dermatologist, so we are not adding anything stronger, and we removed the 30% peel because it is too harsh for skin like this and may leave it looking redder and more irritated. Start with the wash once a day on damp skin, rinse well, and cut back if skin feels tight or sore.
